transcript.text: Good morning, Ms. Brooks. I'd be happy to begin. As the participating teacher, I want to share some findings from a classroom trial I ran with all of my 9th-grade sections. Over a two-week period, I recorded 23 phone-related interruptions. I also tested numbered locking pouches, and they significantly reduced those interruptions. Based on what I observed, I'd recommend we narrow the pilot to grade 9 only and use one pouch per student rather than open classroom bins. I should note that I put these recommendations in my team notes, but they haven't been added to the draft proposal yet. I'd like to formally share those findings with the group now so they're on the record.
